en-US.longDescription: No more guesswork. No need to comb through product pages. The Shure Update Utility has what you need to keep all of your compatible Shure systems up-to-date. All you have to do is download the device firmware, install it over Ethernet or USB, and you’re set.
en-US.name: Shure Update Utility
